messages.text:
The Eureka 16" is a desktop model — at 16 inches it's a generous size for a desk, credenza, or bookshelf, with plenty of presence without needing floor space. It's got raised relief terrain you can feel and a gyromatic base that lets it spin freely in any direction.

You'll find it under that exact name, Eureka 16" Blue Ocean Raised Relief Globe, ready to add to your cart.
